output.explanation: Any visit whose visit_type is not "COV" is accepted. A visit whose visit_type is "COV" is accepted only if open_issues is present and exactly 0.
fails_when: visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is greater than 0
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is negative (anything other than 0 fails)
visit_type is "COV" and open_issues is null or missing: a null counts as a failure, not as zero
Surprising case: the comparison is case-sensitive, so "cov" is not treated as "COV" and passes without any check on open_issues
Surprising case: a null visit_type is not equal to "COV", so the row passes without any check on open_issues
passes_when: visit_type is anything other than "COV" (e.g. "SIV", "IMV"), regardless of open_issues, even if open_issues is null
